instruction: Use only the pinned native workflow supplied on the Desktop: Autodesk Revit 2025 (25.x), Graphisoft Archicad 27 build 6000 or newer, OpenStudio 3.10.0, and its bundled EnergyPlus 25.1.0. The installed entry points are `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit 2025\Revit.exe`, `C:\Program Files\GRAPHISOFT\Archicad 27\Archicad.exe`, and `C:\openstudio-3.10.0\bin\openstudio.exe`. Start from C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc and C:\Users\user\Desktop\workflow_spec.json; do not replace the seed or hand-author delivered IFC, OSM, IDF, SQL, JSON, or CSV artifacts. Run exactly these commands in order: (1) powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\Users\user\Desktop\run_revit_stage.ps1, (2) powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\Users\user\Desktop\run_archicad_stage.ps1, (3) powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\Users\user\Desktop\run_openstudio_stage.ps1. Each launcher must succeed before the next starts. Stage 1 uses the installed EngiWorld Revit IExternalApplication bridge to open init.ifc, preserve the COMMUNITY-ACTIVITY building shell, split the east expansion bay with room-bounding elements, create QUIET-COUNSELLING, and export stage1.ifc plus revit_handoff.json. Stage 2 must launch the installed Archicad 27 IFCCommandServerApp in an isolated task database, call Model.LoadFile on stage1.ifc, call Macro.ValidateIfcModel, query every required entity selection and both IfcSpace GlobalId/Name/LongName values through Entity.Get and Entity.GetAttribute, and call Model.SaveFile to produce stage2.ifc. Record both live JEMI selection counts and independently parsed saved-file entity counts. Preserve all stage1 IfcRoot GlobalIds in stage2, require unique GlobalIds, and record the actual upstream space-boundary state without creating or claiming relationships that are absent from stage1. Generate archicad_validation_report.json and archicad_handoff.json from those live command responses and the verified Revit handoff. Every handoff space row must be keyed by an IfcSpace GlobalId present in stage2.ifc and include area_m2, storey, thermal_zone, schedule category, people, lighting, equipment, and outdoor-air assumptions. Stage 3 must run the supplied OpenStudio Ruby converter against stage2.ifc and archicad_handoff.json, create separate COMMUNITY-ACTIVITY-ZN and QUIET-COUNSELLING-ZN geometry and loads, forward-translate result.osm to in.idf, and execute a real EnergyPlus annual simulation with weather.epw. Required final artifacts are stage1.ifc, revit_handoff.json, stage2.ifc, archicad_validation_report.json, archicad_handoff.json, native_stage_log.json, workflow.osw, result.osm, in.idf, flow_report.json, model_summary.csv, energy_report.csv, run\eplusout.sql, and run\eplusout.err. Preserve revision EW3B01 and all required tokens in workflow_spec.json. The evaluator parses IFC entities and all IfcRoot GlobalIds, cross-checks each Archicad JEMI response against the reported live selection counts, independently parses stage2 entity counts and space GUIDs, compares space/zone areas across the handoff, OSM, IDF, and CSV, verifies native command records and hashes, and opens every standard EnergyPlus SQLite table. It reads every Simulations row, rejects inconsistent flag pairs and fatal Errors records, requires a successful ERR termination, and independently reruns EnergyPlus. On this pinned 25.1 build, an unset FALSE/FALSE completion pair is accepted only when both the submitted run and evaluator-owned rerun have clean successful ERR termination, no fatal Errors record, populated standard result tables, and matching positive energy. The submitted files must support the reported values; JSON alone is not enough.
